foundationCourse.title: Foundation Course

description.para1: The Foundation Course offered by SKY Yoga (also known as Vethathiri Maharishi's Institute) is a comprehensive program that introduces students to the principles of yoga, meditation, and spiritual growth. Here's a brief overview:

objectives: Understand the fundamental principles of yoga and meditation.
Develop physical, mental, and emotional well-being.
Cultivate self-awareness, concentration, and inner peace.
content: Kaya-Kalpa Yoga – the science of rejuvenation.
Simplified exercises: |Movement & rotations. |Asanas (postures) |Pranayama (breathing techniques). |Foot reflexology and acupressure. |Relaxation.
Understanding the chakras and Kundalini energy.
features: Emphasis on practical experience and hands-on training.
Focus on spiritual growth and self-realization.
duration: Course shall be conducted over 7 days with 1.5-hour session per day per week.
Classes held on weekdays and/or weekends.
Combination of theory and practical sessions.
benefits: Circulation of blood, heat, air, and life-force becomes normal and regular.
Ventilates the lungs and increases vital energy.
Improves functioning of the nervous system.
eligibility: Open to beginners and experienced practitioners aged 14 and above only.
No prior knowledge of yoga or meditation required.
foundationCourse.certification: Certificate of completion awarded upon finishing the course.

kayaKalpaCourse.title: Kaya-Kalpa Course

description.para1: Kaya Kalpa Yoga is an ancient rejuvenating technique which was discovered by the Sages (Siddhas) of South India for the intensification of life force. Kaya Kalpa gives significant physical, mental as well as spiritual benefit by intensifying our life-force.
description.para2: This practice is a restructuring process of the body in a natural way, no medicines or herbs are involved. Significant results have been observed in various types of chronic diseases and in overall improvement of general health. Kaya Kalpa helps cure and prevent diseases and relieves the practitioner of many of the troubles of ageing.
description.para3: The science of Kaya Kalpa delineates the manner in which the human body can be revitalised. It has a three-fold objective:
description.pointer3: Live a full span of quality life.

objectives: Attain physical, mental, and emotional well-being.
Delay aging and rejuvenate the body.
features: Emphasis on practical application and experiential learning.
duration: Classes held on weekdays or weekends.
Combination of theory and practical sessions.
benefits: Activates the brain cells to fullest functional levels.
Reduces the effect of hereditary diseases.
Strengthens the uterus; resolves menstrual problems.
Arranges proper polarity of body cells.
Helps in removing unwanted thoughts and habits.
eligibility: Open to practitioners aged 14 and above.
No prior knowledge of yoga or meditation required.
kayaKalpaCourse.certification: Kaya Kalpa certificate awarded upon finishing the course.

introspectionCourse.title: Introspection Course

description.para1: The Introspection Course, also known as 'Self-Enquiry' or 'Atma Vichara,' is a flagship program offered by SKY Yoga (Vethathiri Maharishi's Institute). This course facilitates deep self-analysis, self-reflection, introspection, and spiritual growth.
description.para2: Introspection is a practical methodology for sublimating the negative emotions of greed, anger, vengeance, worries, etc. Strengthen the habits of good thought, word, deed and discerning and rejecting the habits unwanted. By constant research and by leading a virtuous way of life, he dissipates the imprints of sins day by day. As a result, the soul becomes pure, perfection is achieved, and his mind becomes peaceful.
description.para3: Detailed discussions and scientific explanations are provided on subjects such as 'Who Am I?', Imprints of actions and their purification, Karma Yoga, Relationship between Man and Society, Benefits of Blessings, Greatness of Women, Cause and Effect System, Philosophy of Magnetism, Evolution of Universe and Living Beings.

objectives: Understand the nature of the self (Atman) and its relationship with the universe.
Develop self-awareness, introspection, and emotional intelligence.
Cultivate detached-attachment, inner peace, and spiritual growth.
content: Some of the theory and practical lessons on: | Analysis of Thoughts. |Moralization of Desires. |Neutralization of Anger. |Eradication of Worries. |Who am I? |Greatness of Silence. |Greatness of Women and peace in family. |Benefits of Blessings. |Sin imprints and their absolution. |Manoeuvring of six temperaments. |Karma Yoga. |Special meditations.

Special meditations. | Five senses meditation. | Five elements and nine planets meditation. | Chakras or the nine centre meditation. | Intensification of Bio-magnetism. | Meditation on Universal field and Absolute Space.
features: Emphasis on practical application and experiential learning.
duration: Course is divided into three levels, each with a duration of 12 hours.
Classes held on weekdays or weekends.
Combination of theory and practical sessions.
benefits: Control over undue psychic attachment in relationships.
Develop values such as integrity, equanimity, and compassion.
Increased inner peace and stress resilience.
Clarity on life purpose and direction.
eligibility: Completion of SKY Yoga's Foundation Course.
Basic understanding of yoga philosophy and meditation.
Level progression requires completing prior levels.
introspectionCourse.certification: Introspection 1/2/3 certificates awarded upon completion of respective levels.
